SxS 4v4 Team Sim

This is Purrwikimania's team battle simulator, included with its author's permission. The battle report, build advisor and gear affixes are additions, not part of Purrwikimania. Its Nexus teams list holds the two Nexus tournament teams (Fill 1–4 vs 5–8 sets them up), as of 22 November 2026; the other list is a snapshot from the live site.
